name: squids-giftlist
description: Gift-list web app, create lists for any occasion, share a link, and let people claim gifts without spoiling the surprise. React + TypeScript + Firebase.

paragraphs: A gift-list web app: create an account, build gift lists for any occasion (Christmas, birthdays, weddings, and more), organize them into custom sections, and share a link so friends and family can claim gifts without spoiling the surprise — the list owner can never see who claimed what, only the overall progress. Other guests can see claims, so nobody buys the same thing twice.

Built with React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS on the frontend, and Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Hosting) on the backend — deliberately kept to Firebase's free Spark plan: no Cloud Functions, no Cloud Storage, no billing required at all.
features: Multiple lists per user, each with an occasion (Christmas, birthday, wedding, baby shower,
graduation, anniversary, holiday, housewarming, or a custom occasion), an optional event date with a countdown, and a description.
Custom sections within a list (e.g. "Clothes", "Big ticket", "Stocking stuffers"), fully
